notes:
- The pin map now uses 3V3 for power pins (the V-002 runs at 3.3 V). Saved maps convert automatically.
- Probe method (method 3): no 74HCT245 or 5 V step, just ESP32 GPIO > 1k resistor > test lead.
- Wiring guide: direct wiring is now the default (no level shifter needed at 3.3 V).
- New help: picking out the pins the ESP32 needs after sniffing, and what a USB logic analyzer does.
- Includes sign firmware 3.0.3.
